title: 配置管理
Configurations
subtitle: 保存、复用和管理生成规则，打开配置后在工作台编辑。
Save, reuse and manage generation rules. Open a configuration to edit it in the Workbench.
connectToFilter: 连接数据库后可按当前库筛选
Connect a database to filter by the current database
loadUnavailable: 配置暂时无法读取，已保存内容不会因此丢失。
Configurations are temporarily unavailable. Saved content has not been lost.
searchHint: 尝试其他名称，或关闭“仅当前数据库”查看更多配置。
Try another name or turn off Current database only to see more configurations.
emptyHint: 在工作台选择表并保存规则，下次可以直接打开复用。
Select tables and save their rules in the Workbench, then open them again to reuse them.
bulkDeleteHint: 仅删除清单中的配置，运行记录、运行快照和数据库数据均保留。逐份核对版本后删除；部分失败会显示结果，不会自动重试。
Only the listed configurations will be deleted. Run records, snapshots and database data are kept. Versions are checked individually; failures are reported without automatic retries.
unknownDeletion: 未能确认删除结果，请刷新核对
Deletion could not be confirmed; refresh to verify
changedConflict: 配置已被其他操作更新。列表已刷新，请取消后核对最新版本再重试。
The configuration was updated elsewhere. The list has refreshed. Cancel and review the latest version before retrying.
missingConflict: 配置已不存在。请关闭窗口，在更新后的列表中重新选择。
The configuration no longer exists. Close this dialog and select again from the updated list.
name: 配置名称
Configuration name
copyHint: 复制已保存的完整规则，原配置保持不变。
Duplicate all saved rules. The original configuration stays unchanged.
renameHint: 只修改配置名称，生成规则保持不变。
Only the configuration name changes. Generation rules stay unchanged.
nameTooLong: 配置名称不能超过 200 个字符。
The configuration name must not exceed 200 characters.
deleteHint: 只删除这份已保存的配置。运行记录、已提交的运行快照与数据库中的数据都会保留，正在执行的任务继续运行。
Only this saved configuration will be deleted. Run records, submitted snapshots and database data are kept. Running tasks continue.
exportHint: 导出服务器上已保存的生成规则。文件可在工作台导入，不包含数据库连接凭据。
Export the generation rules saved on the server. The file can be imported in the Workbench and contains no database credentials.
loadError: 无法读取配置：{detail}。请重试刷新列表。
Could not load configurations: {detail}. Refresh the list to retry.
deleteList: 将删除以下 {value} 份已保存配置：

deleteList.one: The following {value} saved configuration will be deleted:
deleteList.other: The following {value} saved configurations will be deleted:

deletedSummary: 已删除 {count} 份{missing}{failed}{remaining}。运行记录和数据库数据均保留。
Deleted {count}{missing}{failed}{remaining}. Run records and database data are kept.
deleteFailures: {details}。请返回列表核对最新版本，再重新选择。
{details}. Return to the list, verify the latest versions and select again.
mutationError: 未能确认操作结果：{detail}。请刷新列表核对后再重试。
The result could not be confirmed: {detail}. Refresh the list to verify before retrying.
copied: 已创建“{name}”，可以打开继续编辑。
Created “{name}”. Open it to continue editing.
deleted: 已删除“{name}”。运行记录和数据库数据均保留。
Deleted “{name}”. Run records and database data are kept.
targetRevision: 数据库：{target} · 已保存版本 v{revision}
exported: 已导出 v{revision} 的 {format} 文件。
